claims.text: Oral, highly selective Bruton tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor; reduces hives and pruritus with a favorable safety profile
claims.quote: Remibrutinib is an oral, highly selective Bruton tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor that reduces hives and pruritus while maintaining a favorable safety profile (5).

claims.text: A network meta-analysis put standard-dose omalizumab and remibrutinib among the most effective options for chronic urticaria
claims.quote: One network meta-analysis comparing the efficacy and safety of immunomodulatory treatments for chronic urticaria suggested standard-dose omalizumab and remibrutinib are among the most effective options across several clinical outcomes while also demonstrating favorable safety profiles (6).
